https://www.manchestereveningnews.co.uk/.text: Two Latvian men have been bailed after they were arrested for breaching the perimeter fence at an RAF base in Cambridgeshire, the Press Association reports. The men, aged 36 and 32, were arrested on suspicion of entering a prohibited place for a purpose prejudicial to the UK after being found inside RAF Molesworth at 2am on Thursday (October 8), the Metropolitan Police said. The pair, who are resident in the UK, were taken to a Cambridgeshire police station but have now been released on bail with strict conditions.
